HR Glossary
What is an Appointment Letter?
An appointment letter is an official document given out by the company to the candidate who has been selected for the job.
What is Domain Skills?
Domain skill refers to skills in a specialized profession or discipline. It refers to skills particular in a specific industry or activity.
Assessment Centres
An assessment center is a selection process where individuals are assessed using a wide range of selection practices and exercises.
Skill Test
A skills test is an assessment test used to evaluate the knowledge, skills , abilities of job candidates and to determine if a job applicant has the necessary skills.
Behavioral Competency
Behavioral competency refers to the personality traits or attributes of an individual.Every job required an individual to have hard and soft skills.
Campus Recruitment
Campus recruitment is the process of recruiting young talent directly out of colleges/universities.Also, it is considered one of the best ways to hire fresh talent.
Offer Letter
An offer letter is a formal letter from the employer to the employee. It is a letter indicating that the employee has been selected for the job.
Vacancy
Vacancy refers to an open job position in the company. A vacancy is when there is a job position open for hiring in the company.
Layoff
Downsizing of an organization’s workforce by suspension or permanent termination of a worker or group of workers by the employer.
